Div and span tags stripped but content preserved

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{
		StripTags: []string{`div`, `span`},
	}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<div class='wrapper'><p>Inside div</p></div><p>Outside <span class='hl'>span text</span></p>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
